mapper.sql: chart_account_types.id AS id, chart_account_types.name AS name, chart_account_types.is_active AS status, DATE_FORMAT(chart_account_types.created, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS createdDate, DATE_FORMAT(chart_account_types.modified, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS modifiedDate, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name ) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name ) AS modifiedBy
FROM chart_account_types LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = chart_account_types.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = chart_account_types.modified_by
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM chart_account_types WHERE is_active = 1 AND (name = #{name}) AND id != #{id}
